race.description: The Netty G Happy Wife, Happy Life Hcp (C2)
race.comment: ALDEZOR (2) is the one to beat off a strong start to the season, with two wins from three runs at this track and a proven 1400m record. He was beaten three and a half lengths over 1619m last start but still made ground, and the return to the distance of his narrow win over Truly Gallant gives him a solid platform. BLOOD SAINT (4) has to be forgiven for a last-start failure when caught wide throughout in BM58+ grade, but his previous second to ENCOSTA DE MONEY and his track-and-trip record make him a serious danger. ENCOSTA DE MONEY (3) beat BLOOD SAINT and GOLD LIGHTNING two runs back in CL1 grade, then was beaten two and a half lengths as favourite after racing keenly. GOLD LIGHTNING (9) has placed twice from four starts at this track and distance and was beaten only a nose by ALDEZOR two runs ago, so she remains a live chance if she converts that consistency into a win. ARCHENEMY (1) is next best.
